title: Verify quota saturation and booking isolation
businessObjective: Prove bounded AI/staff workloads cannot consume booking-path capacity or fail open at a resource limit.
technicalObjective: Run deterministic saturation fixtures against quota, queue, workflow, worker, and verification boundaries; record only evidence and no live provider metering.
assumptions: All saturation cases are local deterministic fixtures, not load against guest/staff/production services.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixtures cover all governed budget categories and warnings at 50%, 75%, and 90%.

Pre-hard-limit, missing, unavailable, stale, inconsistent, uncertain, or unknown quota/metering, sustained rate, concurrency, retry, and provider-capacity cases fail closed to pause/requeue/DLQ/block with a deterministic reason.
Tests prove batching/dedupe/idempotency/backpressure/priority behavior and reject per-click persistence or AI invocation.
Booking-path fixture/boundary remains available and has no shared AI/staff credential, quota, deployment, or failure dependency.
Results cannot claim production capacity or authorize a production change.
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
all budget/threshold, metering-uncertainty, and workload negative cases
solEscalationTriggers: Any live load test, booking path access, quota configuration, production integration, or concurrency ambiguity.
rollbackExpectations: Revert fixture/docs/tests only and preserve saturation evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Created by GOV-043 for deterministic saturation evidence only.
